semesters_registration_check.name: semesters_registration_check
semesters_registration_check.value: "semesters"."registration_opens_on" IS NULL OR "semesters"."registration_closes_on" IS NULL OR "semesters"."registration_closes_on" >= "semesters"."registration_opens_on"

semesters_exams_check.name: semesters_exams_check
semesters_exams_check.value: ("semesters"."exams_start_on" IS NULL) = ("semesters"."exams_end_on" IS NULL) AND ("semesters"."exams_start_on" IS NULL OR ("semesters"."exams_end_on" >= "semesters"."exams_start_on" AND "semesters"."exams_start_on" >= "semesters"."starts_on" AND "semesters"."exams_end_on" <= "semesters"."ends_on"))

applications_submitted_check.name: applications_submitted_check
applications_submitted_check.value: "applications"."status" = 'DRAFT' OR ("applications"."reference_no" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."declared_at" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."data_consent_at" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."statement_of_faith_read" AND "applications"."photo_file_id" IS NOT NULL AND "applications"."study_mode" IS NOT NULL)

course_materials_kind_fields.name: course_materials_kind_fields
course_materials_kind_fields.value:
("course_materials"."kind" = 'FILE' AND "course_materials"."file_id" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("course_materials"."kind" = 'LINK' AND "course_materials"."url" IS NOT NULL)
        OR ("course_materials"."kind" = 'TEXT' AND "course_materials"."body_md" IS NOT NULL)
